pool.text: The founding of Harbin occurred with the arrival of the Russian-built Chinese Eastern Railway.
Russian merchant Ivan Yakovlevich Churin founded the Churin Foreign trading company.
The Harbin Railway Administration building was constructed, later suffering destruction and rebuilding.
Leonid Andreyev's play K zvezdam premiered within the city of Harbin.
The Harbin Symphony Orchestra was founded as China's oldest symphony orchestra.
Churin's Sausage Factory was founded, producing European flavor sausage.
Harbin No.1 Music School was founded as the first music school in China.
Chinese warlord Zhang Xueliang seized control of the Chinese Eastern Railway.
Harbin became the primary city within the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo.
The Harbin East Railway Station officially opened for public service.
The main facility of Unit 731 was established in the Pingfang District.
The Soviet Army took control of Harbin toward the end of World War II.
A new communist government was established, making Harbin an early governed large city.
The Harbin Summer Music Month was held and later renamed.
The first formal Concert was held in Harbin Youth Palace.
The Concert was recovered after being stopped by the Cultural Revolution.
Harbin was officially designated as a sub-provincial city by the central committee.
The Harbin International Ice and Snow Sculpture Festival began annual operations.
Harbin Railway Station was expanded following its initial construction.
The Harbin International Trade and Economic Fair commenced its annual run.
